title: Pierre Deligne Papers: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Drafts
version: 2026-06-04 Deligne working record: forward cumulative through paper 016 page 40, reverse papers 090-079 complete plus paper 078 pages 1-12, and complete correspondence reader lane
description:
Dedicated Deligne record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This page is separate from the main corpus so Deligne material can be cited, revised, or reorganized independently.

The top-level files are reader-facing and are intentionally English-first where an English translation is present. Individual English paper PDFs, selected French source/working PDFs, and separate correspondence items are exposed for direct download. Broader reference PDFs and TeX/source artifacts are kept in ZIP files rather than cluttering the front-facing reader list.

Status at a glance. The record has three visible lanes. Substantial working surface: forward paper stream: source-checked working readers cover papers 001-013 complete, paper 014 through page 30, paper 015 complete, and paper 016 through page 40 in the sequential cumulative reader; paper 016 is not yet complete. Stated scope represented: reverse paper stream: source-checked working readers cover papers 090 down through 079 complete and paper 078 pages 1-12 started. Stated scope represented: correspondence lane: twelve Deligne letter/correspondence readers are present in English, each paired with a French working/source PDF. Original/reference and provenance material is preserved in ZIP artifacts and older/raw provenance versions. These are working scholarly transcriptions and translation drafts, not proofed critical editions.

Latest update. Promoted the forward sequential cumulative reader to papers 001-016 through page 40, with a refreshed source-scan/TeX/QA packet. Also added reverse-stream Paper 078 pages 1-12 in English/French, with a refreshed 078-090 TeX/scan/QA source ZIP. The current version is kept at Zenodo's 100-file cap by replacing superseded current-version files and moving bulky provenance back to previous DOI/raw-provenance layers rather than adding duplicates.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Latest metadata update promotes the forward cumulative reader to papers 001-016 through page 40 and adds reverse-stream Paper 078 pages 1-12, with refreshed source-witness TeX/scan/QA packets. Current version remains at the 100-file cap.
